reviews.title: Much better now!
reviews.comment: Hi! Great Upgrade. Made a huge difference. I got this for my desktop (this is for desktops, not laptops). My HP was running super slow—apps were dragging, web pages took forever, and even simple stuff was a pain. Definitely just not enough RAM for what I needed. You probably have at least one memory expansion port in your desktop and so this goes in one of them. Installing it was way easy. You unplug it, take off the case with a screwdriver, find the RAM slots on the motherboard, line up the little notchs, and push it in until it clicks. That's it. It will recognize the new RAM right away. Everything runs smoother now—no more lag, things open fast, and multitasking doesn’t slow it down anymore. If your desktop’s been crawling like mine was, this is 100% worth it.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Exactly What My Computer Needed
reviews.comment: After upgrading from Windows 10 to Windows 11 my Dell Inspiron 3670 was running low on available memory. This item matched exactly the specs of the SK Hynix 8GB stick that was already installed. The price was great, and it arrived 3 days sooner than estimated. I was able to install it easily, and now my computer runs like new.

reviews.title: Works good for a cheap an easy upgrade for any gaming pc
reviews.comment: Bought to upgrade my HP gaming Pavillion desktop tg01 0028 from 8 gig to 16 gig. The memory card itself is slightly different then the factory 8 gb ram card and it doesn't have the greatest click which was off putting for me as someone who is just getting into computers, as I didn't want to break anything but as long as you have the card lined up just put even pressure until the tabs lock and you are good to go, the results are nice much smoother game play, along with staying around 50% of use on large games and even better no issues with the using this with the factory 8 bit card
